entries.zh: 正是、确实如此（应答语：是的，的确）
entries.en: it is so, indeed; certainly, truly

entries.zh: 就是、正是这样（果然属实）
entries.en: it is indeed so; just so, in truth

entries.zh: 是是、确是如此（双重肯定的应答语）
entries.en: it is certainly so; yes, yes indeed

entries.zh: 正是、即是这样（正如我所说的这样）
entries.en: it is just so, as I say
entries.notes: L 栏尾衍文「:hicha」未纳入释义，核心四栏互证清晰

entries.zh: 〔语义无法定夺：L「asi cada mi raudate」讹不可解，汉字「嚇巧」与对音「kě quiào」不合，疑为「可巧、恰巧」一类语气语，无法确证〕
entries.en: [sense undetermined: L garbled; H 嚇巧 possibly 'as it happens, coincidentally' — unverifiable]
entries.notes: 四栏无法互证（L 讹且首字「嚇」与其余各栏不合），依纪律降为低置信

entries.zh: 〔语义无法定夺：L 可读为「如此美丽、令人赞叹」，汉字「嚇親淺」与对音「kě chīn chièn」难确解（疑「可親/欽羨」类赞叹语）〕
entries.en: [sense undetermined: L 'thus beautiful, being admired'; Chinese columns unreconciled]
entries.notes: 首字「嚇」与对音不合，三字语整体无法确解

entries.zh: 〔语义无法定夺：L「如此确实、令人赞叹（于你）」可读，对音疑「可親/可欽」，汉字「嚇親」难确证〕
entries.en: [sense undetermined: L 'thus truly, admiring you'; possibly 'amiable, worthy of admiration' — unverifiable]
entries.notes: 首字「嚇」无法安放，仅 L 与对音约略互证

entries.zh: 〔语义无法定夺：L「asi esposi'ble」讹（疑 posible 或 esponsales），汉字「嚇生年」与对音「kě sēŋ xiēn」无法确解〕
entries.en: [sense undetermined: L garbled ('posible'/'esponsales'?); Chinese columns unreconciled]
entries.notes: 四栏互证失败，依纪律降为低置信

entries.zh: 〔语义无法定夺：L「我就这样身受重伤（倒下）」义明确，但汉字「話向多」与对音「tiām hiāŋ tō」与之不合，疑栏位错位〕
entries.en: [sense undetermined: L 'thus I was left badly wounded' is clear, but the Chinese columns do not correspond]
entries.notes: L 与汉字栏语义冲突，无法定夺

entries.zh: 〔语义无法定夺：L「病人正是这般（躺着）」可读，汉字「卯是向生」与对音「nā zīn hiāŋ sēŋ」难解〕
entries.en: [sense undetermined: L 'thus lies the sick man'; Chinese columns unreadable]
entries.notes: 首字「卯」与对音「nā」不合，四栏无法互证

entries.zh: 〔语义无法定夺：末字「大」与 L「grande」相合，疑为「那（隻）大」一类指大之语，中字「拙」难解〕
entries.en: [sense undetermined: last character 大 matches L 'grande'; middle character unclear]
entries.notes: 疑为「那隻大」但汉字栏作「拙」，无法确证

entries.zh: 〔语义无法定夺：疑与「年」相关（L 尾「yno」≈año），汉字「那只年」整语难解〕
entries.en: [sense undetermined: possibly related to 'year' (L 'yno' ≈ año); phrase 那只年 unreadable]
entries.notes: 中字「只」与 L 讹文难合，无法定夺

entries.zh: 底、底部；器皿之底座（asiento；另涉器皿之成形制作 hechura de vasija）
entries.en: bottom, base; the making/shaping of a vessel (asiento, hechura de vasija)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑：第二字污损（疑渭/湄），依 L「asiento del vino」推为酒滓、酒脚（酒的沉淀物）〕
entries.en: [damaged in original, sense uncertain: lees/dregs of wine per L 'asiento del vino'; second character illegible]
entries.notes: 对音栏第二字标 [残] 且声调 T99 污損難辨

entries.zh: 鼓架；鼓的底座支架
entries.en: drum stand, base of a drum (asiento del atambor)
entries.notes: L「adambor」为 atambor（鼓）之讹写，释义据汉字栏「鼓架」与对音定为鼓架义

entries.zh: 寓、寄居；暂寓他处
entries.en: to sojourn, lodge; dwell (habitar)
entries.notes: L 栏讹甚（hamitar 应为 habitar），释义据汉字「寓」及对音、后文寓居系列定

entries.zh: 寓居、客居（寓居于某处）
entries.en: to dwell, reside in a place; sojourn

entries.zh: 居住、居于
entries.en: to dwell, reside
entries.notes: L「#orat」讹；汉字两字均作「居」而对音「cú chū」相应「居住」，字音不合，依音定为居住义

entries.zh: 居住；栖身
entries.en: to dwell, reside, inhabit (habitar)

entries.zh: 居住于某处；住处、居所
entries.en: to dwell in a place; dwelling place, residence

entries.zh: 住厝、居住于屋舍
entries.en: to live in a house, reside (habitar)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑：义为居住（于屋），L「asittir en caja」之 caja 疑为 casa 之讹，汉字第二字缺损〕
entries.en: [damaged in original, sense uncertain: to dwell, reside (in a house; L 'caja' likely for 'casa'); second character lost]
entries.notes: 汉字栏第二字标 [残]；据居住系列（17–21）推为居住义

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑：词头「A srma」讹，疑为 Asma（哮喘，症见咳嗽）或叹词；依汉字「咳」暂作咳嗽、叹词「咳/嗐」〕
entries.en: [damaged in original, sense uncertain: headword garbled, possibly 'asma' (asthma) or an interjection; tentatively 'cough' / interjection 'ah!' per H 咳]
entries.notes: 词头讹误且对音栏 T99 污損難辨，无法定夺
